verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). A structured API reference (sonar-post schema) and an llms.txt index add further machine-readable surfaces. Missing for 10: first-party docs that point users to the spec download, and evidence the spec covers all APIs (Agent, Search, Embeddings, Orchestrator) completely.
